item.title: Iowa City Drain Cleaning Pros, Ranked: 5 Contenders + 1 Clear Pick
item.description: A slow drain is a warning. Ignore it, and the next clog shows up as water coming through the basement floor drain. This episode walks through six drain cleaning companies serving the Iowa City area, what each one offers, and where their experience holds up. Every company is described from its own website (or its Google or Facebook listing where the website was unavailable). The five contenders are covered in alphabetical order: Ackerman Plumbing, Busy Bee Drain Cleaning, Clog Busters Drain Cleaning & Repair, Phil's Sewer and Drain Cleaning, and Streit's Maintenance. Our top-rated pick is Andy with A-1 Sewer Service: main sewer lines, kitchen sinks, basement floor drains and bathroom drains, cleared with a cable machine at the cleanout, with a camera inspection before anyone talks about digging. Open 24/7, no after-hours fees until 8 p.m. (weekends included), and free, upfront estimates. Find them at 738 Bay Ridge Dr, Iowa City, IA 52246, call (319) 600-4224, or visit https://a1seweriowacity.com/drain-cleaning/. Before you hire, ask what a camera inspection costs if the line keeps clogging, ask about after-hours fees, and get the price before the work starts.

item.title: Iowa City Storm & Water Damage Pros, Ranked: 7 Contenders + 1 Clear Pick
item.description: Hail, straight-line winds, a burst pipe, a flooded basement: in Iowa City, storm and water damage don't wait. This episode walks through eight storm and water damage specialists serving the Iowa City area, what each one focuses on, and where their experience holds up. Every company is described from its own website (or its Google listing where the website was unavailable). The seven contenders are covered in alphabetical order: Firstcall Restoration, Five One Five Restoration, Heartland Roofing, Siding & Solar, My Storm Heroes, SERVPRO of Iowa City, Stormex Restoration & Remodel, and United Water Restoration Group. Our top-rated pick is Michel Cuevas Home Improvement, family-owned in Iowa City since 1997, who find and fix the source of water damage first, then dry and rebuild with their own crews, document storm damage for your insurance adjuster, and keep the number on the estimate the number on the invoice: https://michelcuevashome.com/water-damage-restoration Before you hire, ask who fixes the source of the water, confirm license and insurance, and get the estimate in writing. For homeowners in Iowa City, Coralville, North Liberty, Solon and Cedar Rapids. Ratings as of October 2026. Disclosure: Michel Cuevas Home Improvement is a marketing client of the creator; every company is described from its own published information and reviews.

item.title: Iowa City Water Heater Installers, Ranked: 5 Contenders + 1 Clear Pick
item.description: When a water heater fails, it usually fails on a busy morning, with cold showers and maybe a puddle on the basement floor. This episode walks through six Iowa City-area companies that install water heaters, what each one offers, and where their experience holds up. Every company is described from its own website (or its Google listing where the website was unavailable). The five contenders are covered in alphabetical order: Ackerman Plumbing, Affordable Plumbing & Remodeling, Beachy Plumbing, Colony Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning, and Wichhart Repair. Our top-rated pick is Andy with A-1 Sewer Service, who installs tank and tankless water heaters, checks the gas supply, venting and space before recommending a unit, and prices any gas line or vent changes up front: https://a1seweriowacity.com/water-heater-installation/ Before you hire, ask whether gas and venting changes are included, ask about hauling away the old tank, and get the quote in writing. For homeowners in Iowa City, Coralville, North Liberty, Tiffin and Cedar Rapids. Ratings as of October 2026.
